Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo today — super helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our security and legal teams:

1) We need a formal confirmation that AcmeFin data will not be used for model training or model improvement when sent to Redwood's hosted API.
2) Please confirm what logging is captured (request/response, IP, tokenization traces) and the retention periods.
3) We need an explanation of any PII handling and what controls exist for redaction/segmentation.
4) Data residency: our production data must remain in the us-east-1 region.

Can you confirm in writing and attach any amendment or opt-out form we should sign? Our legal team would like a short doc to include in the contract amendments.

Thanks,
John

Hi John — great to meet today, and thanks for the detailed list. Per our conversation, here is the written confirmation and the steps we’ll take to meet AcmeFin’s requirements. I’ve looped in Marissa (legal ops) and Rishi (product security) for visibility.

Summary (short):
- Training opt-out: Redwood will not use AcmeFin data for model training or model improvement.
- Logging & retention: request/response payloads are logged for 30 days for debugging and billing; request metadata (timestamps, model used, token counts) retained for 365 days. Access to full request/response logs is restricted to authorized platform engineers and requires an approved ticket.
- PII handling: we recommend customer-side redaction for high-risk PII. Redwood offers optional automated redaction filters (PII masking) that can be enabled per route; enabling is a configuration change.
- Data residency: we will provision your production traffic in us-east-1 and ensure logs and backups remain in the same region.

Attached: redwood-training-opt-out-acmefin-20270425.pdf (formal opt-out confirmation) and a draft data-processing amendment for signature.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached opt-out confirmation and DPA draft.
2) If acceptable, return the signed amendment or confirm over email and we’ll update the account.
3) If you’d like automated PII redaction enabled, tell us the routes and we’ll flip the flag in staging for testing.

I’ll also post the opt-out flag on your account record so it applies to hosted API traffic for the account/keys tied to AcmeFin.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123
